style:
<style>
.home-root{
  width:100%;
  margin:0 auto;
  padding-bottom:26px
}

.home-hero{
  position:relative;
  min-height:330px;
  overflow:hidden;
  margin:0 0 16px;
  border-radius:20px;
  color:#fff;
  background-image:
    linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(3,31,48,.92) 0%,rgba(4,47,64,.70) 46%,rgba(4,37,52,.20) 76%,rgba(4,37,52,.18) 100%),
    var(--pda-photo-net);
  background-size:cover;
  background-position:center 46%;
  box-shadow:0 16px 42px rgba(3,30,42,.15)
}
.home-hero::before{
  content:"";
  position:absolute;
  inset:auto 0 0;
  height:44%;
  background:linear-gradient(180deg,transparent,rgba(3,29,45,.18));
  pointer-events:none
}
.home-hero-content{
  position:relative;
  z-index:1;
  display:flex;
  min-height:330px;
  width:min(720px,70%);
  flex-direction:column;
  justify-content:flex-end;
  padding:38px 42px 36px
}
.home-eyebrow{
  display:block;
  width:max-content;
  margin:0 0 10px;
  color:#b8e3e6;
  font-size:8.5px;
  font-weight:850;
  letter-spacing:.19em
}
.home-hero h2{
  max-width:620px;
  margin:0!important;
  color:#fff!important;
  font-family:var(--pda-display)!important;
  font-size:clamp(42px,5.1vw,74px)!important;
  font-weight:600!important;
  line-height:.92!important;
  letter-spacing:-.047em!important;
  text-shadow:0 3px 22px rgba(0,0,0,.28)
}
.home-hero h2::after{
  content:"";
  display:block;
  width:116px;
  height:7px;
  margin-top:12px;
  transform:rotate(-2deg);
  border-radius:99px;
  background:var(--pda-coral);
  box-shadow:0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.18)
}
.home-hero-content>p{
  max-width:650px;
  margin:15px 0 0!important;
  color:#f1f7f7!important;
  font-size:15px!important;
  line-height:1.48!important;
  text-shadow:0 1px 10px rgba(0,0,0,.25)
}
.home-hero-meta{
  display:flex;
  flex-wrap:wrap;
  gap:0;
  margin-top:19px;
  color:#d7e6e8;
  font-size:9px;
  font-weight:700
}
.home-hero-meta span{
  display:inline-flex;
  align-items:center
}
.home-hero-meta span+span::before{
  content:"•";
  margin:0 9px;
  color:var(--pda-coral)
}

.home-headline-metrics{
  position:relative;
  z-index:4;
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr));
  gap:10px;
  margin:-48px 18px 14px
}
.home-metric{
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:54px minmax(0,1fr);
  align-items:center;
  gap:11px;
  min-height:104px;
  padding:15px 16px;
  border:1px solid rgba(224,220,210,.92);
  border-radius:15px;
  background:rgba(255,253,249,.97);
  box-shadow:0 12px 30px rgba(17,47,57,.10);
  backdrop-filter:blur(10px)
}
.home-metric-icon{
  display:grid;
  place-items:center;
  width:52px;
  height:52px;
  border-radius:50%;
  color:#fff;
  background:#1d7890
}
.home-metric:nth-child(2) .home-metric-icon{background:#d66a52}
.home-metric:nth-child(3) .home-metric-icon{background:#d49a42}
.home-metric:nth-child(4) .home-metric-icon{background:#238d8f}
.home-metric-icon svg{
  width:26px;
  height:26px;
  fill:none;
  stroke:currentColor;
  stroke-width:1.7;
  stroke-linecap:round;
  stroke-linejoin:round
}
.home-metric-copy{
  min-width:0
}
.home-metric-copy strong{
  display:block;
  overflow:hidden;
  color:var(--pda-ink);
  font-family:var(--pda-display);
  font-size:25px;
  font-weight:650;
  line-height:1.05;
  letter-spacing:-.025em;
  text-overflow:ellipsis;
  white-space:nowrap
}
.home-metric-copy>span{
  display:block;
  margin-top:3px;
  color:#304d58;
  font-size:9.5px;
  font-weight:800
}
.home-metric-copy small{
  display:block;
  margin-top:3px;
  color:#7b8883;
  font-size:7.8px;
  line-height:1.3
}

.home-secondary-metrics{
  display:flex;
  flex-wrap:wrap;
  gap:0;
  margin:0 2px 26px;
  padding:0 4px
}
.home-secondary-metric{
  display:flex;
  align-items:baseline;
  gap:6px;
  padding:5px 16px 5px 0;
  color:#556b69
}
.home-secondary-metric+.home-secondary-metric{
  padding-left:16px;
  border-left:1px solid #ddd8cf
}
.home-secondary-metric strong{
  color:var(--pda-sea);
  font-family:var(--pda-display);
  font-size:18px;
  font-weight:650
}
.home-secondary-metric span{
  color:#687875;
  font-size:8.5px;
  font-weight:650
}

.home-section-title{
  display:flex;
  align-items:flex-end;
  justify-content:space-between;
  gap:12px;
  margin:0 0 10px
}
.home-section-title h3,
.home-panel-head h3{
  margin:0;
  color:var(--pda-ink);
  font-family:var(--pda-display);
  font-size:20px;
  font-weight:650;
  letter-spacing:-.02em
}
.home-section-title p,
.home-panel-head p{
  margin:3px 0 0!important;
  font-size:9px!important
}

.home-action-grid{
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr));
  gap:10px;
  margin:0 0 24px
}
.home-action-card{
  position:relative;
  display:flex!important;
  min-height:184px!important;
  flex-direction:column!important;
  align-items:flex-start!important;
  justify-content:flex-end!important;
  gap:7px!important;
  overflow:hidden!important;
  padding:17px!important;
  border:0!important;
  border-radius:16px!important;
  color:#fff!important;
  text-align:left!important;
  background:#123f52!important;
  background-size:cover!important;
  background-position:center!important;
  box-shadow:0 10px 24px rgba(17,49,60,.12)!important;
  isolation:isolate
}
.home-action-card::before{
  content:"";
  position:absolute;
  inset:0;
  z-index:-1;
  background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(4,26,37,.04) 15%,rgba(4,31,44,.32) 45%,rgba(2,26,38,.92) 100%)
}
.home-action-card::after{
  content:"";
  position:absolute;
  inset:0;
  z-index:-1;
  border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.14);
  border-radius:inherit
}
.home-action-card:hover{
  transform:translateY(-2px)!important;
  border-color:transparent!important;
  box-shadow:0 16px 34px rgba(17,49,60,.18)!important
}
.home-action-photo-community{background-image:var(--pda-photo-community)!important}
.home-action-photo-channel{background-image:var(--pda-photo-channel)!important}
.home-action-photo-boat{background-image:var(--pda-photo-boat)!important}
.home-action-photo-net{background-image:var(--pda-photo-net)!important}
.home-action-photo-port{background-image:var(--pda-photo-port)!important}
.home-action-pess,
.home-action-acomp,
.home-action-proc{
  grid-column:auto
}
.home-action-min,
.home-action-dist,
.home-action-adm{
  min-height:148px!important
}
.home-action-icon{
  display:grid;
  place-items:center;
  width:36px;
  height:36px;
  border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.28);
  border-radius:11px;
  color:#fff;
  background:rgba(2,35,49,.42);
  backdrop-filter:blur(7px)
}
.home-action-icon svg{
  width:20px;
  height:20px;
  fill:none;
  stroke:currentColor;
  stroke-width:1.8;
  stroke-linecap:round;
  stroke-linejoin:round
}
.home-action-copy{
  display:grid;
  gap:2px;
  min-width:0
}
.home-action-copy strong{
  color:#fff;
  font-size:13px;
  font-weight:800;
  line-height:1.18;
  text-shadow:0 1px 10px rgba(0,0,0,.3)
}
.home-action-copy small{
  max-width:220px;
  color:rgba(255,255,255,.88);
  font-size:8.5px;
  font-weight:500;
  line-height:1.35
}
.home-action-arrow{
  position:absolute;
  right:14px;
  bottom:14px;
  display:grid;
  place-items:center;
  width:30px;
  height:30px;
  border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.26);
  border-radius:50%;
  color:#fff;
  background:rgba(2,35,49,.38);
  backdrop-filter:blur(6px)
}
.home-action-card:hover .home-action-arrow{
  transform:translateX(2px)
}

.home-lower-grid{
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;
  gap:12px;
  margin:0 0 18px
}
.home-panel,
.home-territory{
  padding:0!important;
  border:1px solid #ddd9d0!important;
  border-radius:14px!important;
  background:rgba(255,253,249,.97)!important;
  box-shadow:0 7px 20px rgba(17,49,60,.05)!important
}
.home-panel-head{
  display:flex;
  align-items:center;
  justify-content:space-between;
  gap:12px;
  min-height:56px;
  padding:13px 16px;
  border-bottom:1px solid #e6e1d8
}
.home-panel-head button{
  min-height:29px!important;
  padding:5px 9px!important;
  font-size:8.5px!important
}
.home-recent-list,
.home-timeline{
  display:grid
}
.home-recent-person{
  display:grid!important;
  grid-template-columns:34px minmax(0,1fr) 20px!important;
  align-items:center!important;
  gap:9px!important;
  width:100%!important;
  min-height:52px!important;
  padding:8px 15px!important;
  border:0!important;
  border-bottom:1px solid #ece7de!important;
  border-radius:0!important;
  color:var(--pda-ink)!important;
  text-align:left!important;
  background:transparent!important;
  box-shadow:none!important
}
.home-recent-person:last-child{border-bottom:0!important}
.home-recent-person:hover{
  transform:none!important;
  background:#f2f5f2!important
}
.home-avatar{
  display:grid;
  place-items:center;
  width:32px;
  height:32px;
  border-radius:50%;
  color:#fff;
  background:var(--pda-sea);
  font-size:8px;
  font-weight:800
}
.home-recent-copy{
  display:grid;
  min-width:0;
  gap:1px
}
.home-recent-copy strong{
  overflow:hidden;
  color:#2c4854;
  font-size:9.5px;
  text-overflow:ellipsis;
  white-space:nowrap
}
.home-recent-copy small{
  overflow:hidden;
  color:#7b8783;
  font-size:8px;
  text-overflow:ellipsis;
  white-space:nowrap
}
.home-recent-arrow{color:#82928f}

.home-timeline-item{
  position:relative;
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:10px minmax(0,1fr);
  gap:8px;
  min-height:50px;
  padding:9px 15px;
  border-bottom:1px solid #ece7de
}
.home-timeline-item:last-child{border-bottom:0}
.home-timeline-dot{
  width:7px;
  height:7px;
  margin-top:5px;
  border-radius:50%;
  background:var(--pda-coral);
  box-shadow:0 0 0 4px rgba(198,90,67,.10)
}
.home-timeline-item strong{
  display:block;
  color:#35515c;
  font-size:9.5px;
  line-height:1.32
}
.home-timeline-item small{
  display:block;
  margin-top:2px;
  color:#7a8783;
  font-size:7.8px
}

.home-territory{
  margin-top:0
}
.home-updated{
  color:#7c8784;
  font-size:8px
}
.home-territory-bars{
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));
  gap:12px 22px;
  padding:14px 16px 16px
}
.home-territory-label{
  display:flex;
  justify-content:space-between;
  gap:8px;
  margin-bottom:5px;
  color:#60706c;
  font-size:8.5px
}
.home-territory-label strong{color:var(--pda-sea)}
.home-territory-track{
  height:4px;
  overflow:hidden;
  border-radius:99px;
  background:#e4e0d7
}
.home-territory-fill{
  display:block;
  height:100%;
  border-radius:99px;
  background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--pda-sea),#3da0a5)
}

@media(min-width:1180px){
  .home-action-pess,
  .home-action-acomp,
  .home-action-defeso,
  .home-action-tarefas{
    min-height:192px!important
  }
  .home-action-dist,
  .home-action-proc{
    grid-column:span 2
  }
}

@media(max-width:1160px){
  .home-headline-metrics{
    grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));
    margin-top:-32px
  }
  .home-action-grid{
    grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))
  }
  .home-territory-bars{
    grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))
  }
}

@media(max-width:760px){
  .home-hero{
    min-height:290px;
    border-radius:14px
  }
  .home-hero-content{
    min-height:290px;
    width:100%;
    padding:28px 22px 24px
  }
  .home-hero h2{
    max-width:520px;
    font-size:40px!important
  }
  .home-hero-content>p{
    font-size:12px!important
  }
  .home-headline-metrics{
    grid-template-columns:1fr;
    margin:10px 0 14px
  }
  .home-metric{
    min-height:86px
  }
  .home-action-grid,
  .home-lower-grid,
  .home-territory-bars{
    grid-template-columns:1fr
  }
  .home-action-card,
  .home-action-min,
  .home-action-dist,
  .home-action-adm{
    min-height:160px!important
  }
  .home-secondary-metrics{
    display:grid;
    grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr
  }
  .home-secondary-metric,
  .home-secondary-metric+.home-secondary-metric{
    padding:5px 8px 5px 0;
    border-left:0
  }
}


/* Início compacto — etapa 3 */
.home-root{padding-bottom:12px!important}
.home-hero{
  min-height:220px!important;
  margin-bottom:10px!important;
  border-radius:16px!important;
  background-position:center 48%!important
}
.home-hero-content{
  min-height:220px!important;
  width:min(650px,72%)!important;
  padding:24px 30px 22px!important
}
.home-hero h2{
  font-size:clamp(34px,4vw,56px)!important
}
.home-hero h2::after{
  width:88px!important;
  height:5px!important;
  margin-top:8px!important
}
.home-hero-content>p{
  margin-top:10px!important;
  font-size:12px!important
}
.home-headline-metrics{
  grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr))!important;
  gap:8px!important;
  margin:-28px 12px 13px!important
}
.home-metric{
  position:relative;
  grid-template-columns:42px minmax(0,1fr)!important;
  gap:9px!important;
  min-height:82px!important;
  padding:11px 12px!important;
  border-radius:12px!important
}
.home-metric-icon{
  width:40px!important;
  height:40px!important
}
.home-metric-icon svg{
  width:21px!important;
  height:21px!important
}
.home-metric-copy strong{
  font-size:20px!important
}
.home-metric-copy>span{
  font-size:8.5px!important
}
.home-metric-copy small{
  margin-top:1px!important;
  font-size:7px!important
}
.home-metric-link{
  position:absolute!important;
  right:8px!important;
  bottom:7px!important;
  min-height:23px!important;
  padding:3px 6px!important;
  font-size:6.8px!important;
  opacity:.82
}
.home-section-title{
  margin-bottom:7px!important
}
.home-section-title h3{
  font-size:17px!important
}
.home-section-title>button{
  min-height:30px!important;
  font-size:7.8px!important
}
.home-action-grid{
  grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr))!important;
  gap:8px!important;
  margin-bottom:10px!important
}
.home-action-card,
.home-action-pess,
.home-action-acomp,
.home-action-defeso,
.home-action-tarefas,
.home-action-dist,
.home-action-proc{
  grid-column:auto!important;
  min-height:124px!important;
  padding:13px!important;
  border-radius:13px!important
}
.home-action-icon{
  width:31px!important;
  height:31px!important
}
.home-action-icon svg{
  width:17px!important;
  height:17px!important
}
.home-action-copy strong{
  font-size:11px!important
}
.home-action-copy small{
  max-width:200px!important;
  font-size:7.4px!important
}
.home-action-arrow{
  width:25px!important;
  height:25px!important;
  right:10px!important;
  bottom:10px!important
}
.home-compact-footer{
  display:flex;
  flex-wrap:wrap;
  gap:0;
  padding:7px 0 0;
  color:#6e7c78;
  font-size:7.5px
}
.home-compact-footer span{
  padding:2px 12px 2px 0
}
.home-compact-footer span+span{
  padding-left:12px;
  border-left:1px solid #ddd8cf
}
@media(max-width:1100px){
  .home-headline-metrics{
    grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))!important;
    margin:0 0 12px!important
  }
  .home-action-grid{
    grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))!important
  }
}
@media(max-width:650px){
  .home-hero,
  .home-hero-content{
    min-height:190px!important
  }
  .home-hero-content{
    width:100%!important;
    padding:20px!important
  }
  .home-headline-metrics,
  .home-action-grid{
    grid-template-columns:1fr!important
  }
  .home-action-card{
    min-height:108px!important
  }
}


/* Contraste do título sobre fotografias variáveis */
.home-hero .home-hero-content h2{
  color:#fff!important;
  text-shadow:
    0 2px 5px rgba(0,0,0,.58),
    0 7px 28px rgba(0,0,0,.38)!important
}
.home-hero .home-hero-content>p{
  color:#f7fbfb!important;
  text-shadow:0 2px 12px rgba(0,0,0,.46)!important
}
</style>
script:
<script>
window.PDA_MODULES.PAINEL=(()=>{
  const {el,button,call,go,alive}=App;

  const ICONS={
    cadastro:'<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><circle cx="9" cy="8" r="3"></circle><path d="M3.7 18.5c.7-3.3 2.6-5 5.3-5s4.6 1.7 5.3 5"></path><path d="M18 8v6M15 11h6"></path></svg>',
    consulta:'<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><circle cx="10.5" cy="10.5" r="5.8"></circle><path d="M15 15l5 5"></path></svg>',
    defeso:'<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M6 3.5h9l3 3V20H6zM15 3.5V7h3M8.8 11h6.4M8.8 14h6.4"></path></svg>',
    tarefas:'<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M6 4h12v16H6zM9 8h6M9 12h6M9 16h3"></path></svg>',
    distribuicao:'<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><circle cx="5" cy="12" r="2"></circle><circle cx="19" cy="6" r="2"></circle><circle cx="19" cy="18" r="2"></circle><path d="M7 11l10-4M7 13l10 4"></path></svg>',
    processo:'<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M5 4h10l4 4v12H5zM15 4v5h4M8 12h8M8 15h8"></path></svg>',
    historico:'<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="8"></circle><path d="M12 7v5l3 2M5 4v4h4"></path></svg>',
    people:'<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><circle cx="9" cy="8" r="3"></circle><path d="M3.5 19c.7-3.6 2.6-5.4 5.5-5.4s4.8 1.8 5.5 5.4"></path></svg>',
    money:'<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M4 6h16v12H4z"></path><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="3"></circle></svg>',
    pending:'<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="8"></circle><path d="M12 7v6M12 16.5h.01"></path></svg>',
    cases:'<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M4 7h16v13H4zM8 7V4h8v3M4 12h16"></path></svg>'
  };

  const number_=value=>Number(value||0).toLocaleString('pt-BR');
  const money_=value=>Number(value||0).toLocaleString('pt-BR',{style:'currency',currency:'BRL'});

  function icon_(name){
    const node=el('span',undefined,'home-action-icon');
    node.innerHTML=ICONS[name]||ICONS.consulta;
    return node;
  }

  function metric_(value,label,detail,iconName,action){
    const box=el('article',undefined,'home-metric');
    const icon=el('span',undefined,'home-metric-icon');
    icon.innerHTML=ICONS[iconName]||ICONS.people;
    const copy=el('div',undefined,'home-metric-copy');
    copy.append(el('strong',value),el('span',label),el('small',detail));
    box.append(icon,copy);
    if(action){
      const link=button(action.label,action.fn,true);
      link.classList.add('home-metric-link');
      box.append(link);
    }
    return box;
  }

  function action_(item){
    const card=el('button',undefined,'home-action-card home-action-'+String(item.code||'').toLowerCase()+' home-action-photo-'+item.photo);
    card.type='button';
    card.dataset.moduleCode=
      String(item.code||'');
    card.onclick=()=>go(item.code);
    const copy=el('span',undefined,'home-action-copy');
    copy.append(el('strong',item.title),el('small',item.description));
    card.append(icon_(item.icon),copy,el('span','→','home-action-arrow'));
    return card;
  }

  return async function(ctx){
    const root=ctx.root;
    const boot=App.state.boot||{};
    const user=boot.usuario||{};
    const d=await call('painel');
    if(!alive(ctx))return;

    const hero=el('section',undefined,'home-hero');
    const heroContent=el('div',undefined,'home-hero-content');
    heroContent.append(
      el('span','PROJETO POVO DAS ÁGUAS','home-eyebrow'),
      el('h2','Bem-vindo, '+(user.nomeUsuario||user.nome||'usuário').split(/\s+/)[0]),
      el('p','Atendimento, documentação e gestão jurídica das comunidades pesqueiras.')
    );
    hero.append(heroContent);
    root.append(hero);

    const panelVisualUsed=[];

    const applyVisual_=dataUrl=>{
      if(!dataUrl)return;

      hero.style.backgroundImage=
        'linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(3,31,48,.92) 0%,rgba(4,47,64,.70) 46%,rgba(4,37,52,.20) 76%,rgba(4,37,52,.18) 100%),url("'+
        dataUrl+
        '")';
    };

    let cachedHero=null;

    try{
      cachedHero=
        JSON.parse(
          sessionStorage.getItem(
            'PDA_VISUAL_PAINEL_V2'
          )||
          'null'
        );
    }catch(e){}

    if(
      cachedHero&&
      cachedHero.dataUrl
    ){
      applyVisual_(
        cachedHero.dataUrl
      );

      if(cachedHero.id){
        panelVisualUsed.push(
          cachedHero.id
        );
      }
    }

    const metrics=el('section',undefined,'home-headline-metrics');
    metrics.append(
      metric_(number_(d.pessoas),'Pessoas cadastradas','Cadastros ativos.','people',{
        label:'Histórico',
        fn:()=>go('HIST')
      }),
      metric_(number_(d.acoesTramitacao),'Processos','Ações registradas.','cases',{
        label:'Consultar',
        fn:()=>go('PROC')
      }),
      metric_(number_(d.minhasTarefas),'Minhas tarefas','Demandas abertas para você.','pending',{
        label:'Abrir',
        fn:()=>go('TAREFAS')
      }),
      metric_(money_(d.valorCausas),'Valor das causas','Base das parcelas cadastradas.','money')
    );
    root.append(metrics);

    const heading=el('div',undefined,'home-section-title');
    const headingCopy=el('div');
    headingCopy.append(
      el('h3','Ações rápidas'),
      el('p','Acesse diretamente o fluxo que precisa executar.','hint')
    );
    const history=button('Consultar histórico',()=>go('HIST'),true);
    heading.append(headingCopy,history);
    root.append(heading);

    const actions=el('section',undefined,'home-action-grid');
    const available=boot.modulos||{};

    [
      {code:'PESS',title:'Novo Cadastro',description:'Cadastrar pessoa e documentos.',icon:'cadastro',photo:'community'},
      {code:'ACOMP',title:'Consultar Cadastros',description:'Localizar pessoas e abrir ficha rápida.',icon:'consulta',photo:'channel'},
      {code:'DEFESO',title:'Seguro-Defeso 2025',description:'Consultar CPF/NIS na base oficial.',icon:'defeso',photo:'boat'},
      {code:'TAREFAS',title:'Minhas tarefas',description:'Prazos, mensagens e anexos.',icon:'tarefas',photo:'net'},
      {code:'DIST',title:'Distribuição',description:'Atribuir e acompanhar tarefas.',icon:'distribuicao',photo:'port'},
      {code:'PROC',title:'Processos',description:'Consultar processos registrados.',icon:'processo',photo:'boat'}
    ]
      .filter(item=>!!available[item.code])
      .forEach(item=>actions.append(action_(item)));

    root.append(actions);

    /*
     * As fotos são aplicadas depois que o Painel já está utilizável.
     * A composição fica estável durante a sessão e evita repetir a mesma
     * fotografia entre o hero e os cartões visíveis.
     */
    (async()=>{
      try{
        if(!cachedHero){
          const image=
            await call(
              'imagemSistemaAleatoria',
              {
                uso:'PAINEL',
                excluirIds:
                  panelVisualUsed
              },
              false,
              {noLoader:true}
            );

          if(
            image&&
            image.base64&&
            image.mime&&
            alive(ctx)
          ){
            const dataUrl=
              'data:'+
              image.mime+
              ';base64,'+
              image.base64;

            cachedHero={
              id:image.id,
              dataUrl
            };

            panelVisualUsed.push(
              image.id
            );

            applyVisual_(
              dataUrl
            );

            try{
              sessionStorage.setItem(
                'PDA_VISUAL_PAINEL_V2',
                JSON.stringify(
                  cachedHero
                )
              );
            }catch(e){}
          }
        }

        let cachedActions={};

        try{
          cachedActions=
            JSON.parse(
              sessionStorage.getItem(
                'PDA_VISUAL_PAINEL_ACTIONS_V2'
              )||
              '{}'
            )||
            {};
        }catch(e){}

        const cards=
          Array.from(
            actions.querySelectorAll(
              '.home-action-card'
            )
          );

        for(const card of cards){
          if(
            !alive(ctx)||
            !card.isConnected
          ){
            return;
          }

          const code=
            String(
              card.dataset.moduleCode||
              ''
            );

          const cached=
            cachedActions[code];

          if(
            cached&&
            cached.dataUrl
          ){
            card.style.setProperty(
              'background-image',
              'url("'+
              cached.dataUrl+
              '")',
              'important'
            );

            if(
              cached.id&&
              !panelVisualUsed.includes(
                cached.id
              )
            ){
              panelVisualUsed.push(
                cached.id
              );
            }

            continue;
          }

          const usage=
            code==='PROC'
              ?'INSTITUCIONAL'
              :code==='ACOMP'
                ?'TERRITORIO'
                :'PAINEL';

          const image=
            await call(
              'imagemSistemaAleatoria',
              {
                uso:usage,
                excluirIds:
                  panelVisualUsed
              },
              false,
              {noLoader:true}
            );

          if(
            !image||
            !image.base64||
            !image.mime
          ){
            continue;
          }

          const dataUrl=
            'data:'+
            image.mime+
            ';base64,'+
            image.base64;

          panelVisualUsed.push(
            image.id
          );

          card.style.setProperty(
            'background-image',
            'url("'+
            dataUrl+
            '")',
            'important'
          );

          cachedActions[code]={
            id:image.id,
            dataUrl
          };

          try{
            sessionStorage.setItem(
              'PDA_VISUAL_PAINEL_ACTIONS_V2',
              JSON.stringify(
                cachedActions
              )
            );
          }catch(e){}
        }

      }catch(e){}
    })();

    const compact=el('div',undefined,'home-compact-footer');
    compact.append(
      el('span',number_(d.documentos)+' documentos vigentes'),
      el('span',number_(d.aConferir)+' aguardando conferência'),
      el('span',number_(d.iniciais)+' petições iniciais'),
      el('span',number_(d.relatorios)+' relatórios Defeso')
    );
    root.append(compact);
  };
})();
</script>
